_comment: Copy to your PROJECT ROOT as sdlc-verify.json (or agent_state/config/verify-commands.json) to turn on verify-gate.sh check (e) — EXECUTION-GROUNDED verification. When present, the gate RUNS these commands and BLOCKS on a non-zero exit, so a phase cannot pass by merely CLAIMING tests passed. Absent = the check is an advisory skip. Commands run from the project root via `bash -c`. Provide any subset; empty/omitted keys are skipped.
